# ADR-000 — Starter Kit Adoption

## Status

Proposed / Accepted / Superseded

## Context

Which starter components were provided, and what project problem are they intended to support?

## Decision

Which components will the team retain, modify, replace, or remove?

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches were considered?

## Rationale

Why is this approach appropriate for the project requirements, constraints, risks, and quality attributes?

## Consequences

What benefits, limitations, migration work, risks, or technical debt result?
